newsitem.title: USA: Energy Search producing W.Virginia gas.
newsitem.headline: Energy Search producing W.Virginia gas.

text.p: Energy Search Inc said Thursday it has started natural gas deliveries from its 17,000 acre Beaver lease in West Virginia through the Columbia Gas System Inc pipeline system.

Energy Search said the initial production of 3 million cubic feet per day from seven wells should increase revenues by about $2.7 million during the coming 12 months of operation. "We expect to increase our production up to 8 million cubic feet per day out of this field."

The company anticipates the remaining five million cubic feet of daily production will come from the remaining eight wells already drilled and completed, plus 13 more to be drilled and completed by September 30.
